_comment: Adversarial fixture for debug_panel_fidelity.py. Raw DB-form conversation messages (role+content+toolRounds), NOT OpenAI wire form. Designed to exercise each WIRE-subset transform. See notes per message.

messages._note: (gateway term) contains a provider-blocked keyword to prove _sanitize_messages fires unconditionally in the offline subset (point 3 approximation).
messages.content: Tell me about the 习近平 economic policy report.

messages._note: (a full toolRounds + reorder) one llmRound batch, two calls whose toolCallIds are in REVERSE lexical order (call_zzz before call_aaa). Reconstruction emits tool results in [zzz, aaa]; sort_tool_results must reorder to [aaa, zzz].
(d empty user) whitespace-only content. Survives builder (neighbors are tool then assistant, not same-role). WIRE _fix_empty_user_messages must replace with '[empty message]'.

(c consecutive same-role probe #1) plain assistant. The builder's own _merge_consecutive_same_role should already merge this with the next assistant in COLD — proving the WIRE merge is redundant on builder output (a finding, not a failure).
(c consecutive same-role probe #2) second consecutive plain assistant.
